enterprise_teaser.headline: Need EU AI Act compliance?
enterprise_teaser.body: If your company uses AI in high-risk contexts — hiring, credit scoring, automated decisions — the EU AI Act creates obligations you can't ignore. Fines reach up to €35 million.
enterprise_teaser.body_2: We run compliance audits, deploy observability, and write the documentation that regulators actually accept.

stakes.headline: The EU AI Act isn't coming. It's here.
stakes.body_1: The regulation entered into force in August 2024. Prohibitions on unacceptable AI practices apply from February 2025. High-risk system requirements hit in August 2026. The compliance clock is already running.

stat_1.label: Maximum fine for prohibited AI practices

stat_2.label: Of global annual turnover for serious violations

stat_3.label: Obligations for high-risk AI system deployers

stakes.body_2: If your company uses AI for hiring, credit scoring, content moderation, customer profiling, or automated decision-making — you're almost certainly in scope. Even off-the-shelf AI tools can trigger deployer obligations under the Act.
stakes.body_3: The question isn't whether you need to comply. It's whether you'll do it proactively or under enforcement pressure.
